capabilities: Synchronize the vault with a Git remote
Auto-commit and push on file changes with debouncing
Pull from the remote on vault startup
Clone a remote into the vault or initialize a repository
Write a detailed sync audit log to _System/SyncLog.md
disambiguation: Despite the all-in-one name, the README currently documents only a Git Sync module.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation requires manually copying release files into the plugins folder.
problem: Vault syncing options either use proprietary cloud services or need native Git binaries, and existing Git approaches often fail on Android.

relations.evidence: Connect with GitHub OAuth or paste a Personal Access Token

summary: All-in-one plugin whose current module provides Git-based vault synchronization using isomorphic-git, with auto commit-push, startup pull, and a sync log.
